basis.governing_question: How can Grupo Vale integrate the sales, purchasing and finance of the three regional food distributors it bought into its own?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Assess how sales, purchasing and finance work today at Grupo Vale and the three acquired distributors.

gate.label: Scope and sequence
gate.decision: Which integration scope and company sequence goes forward into design?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the integration plan for sales, purchasing and finance across the three companies, ready for board approval.

gate.label: Go/no-go on rollout
gate.decision: Go or no-go on rolling out the first company under this integration plan?

phases.name: Implementation
phases.objective_one_line: Move the first acquired company's sales, purchasing and finance onto Grupo Vale's processes and systems.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Do we approve the plan and first-company results to take to the 29 January board?

architect_notes: Length is an estimate: the archetype's shortest Diagnostic and Design leave no room for Implementation in the 12 weeks available, so the phases total 9-12 weeks.
Rollout of the first company starts before the board approves the plan on 29 January; confirm the steering group can authorize it.
Departure from operating_model_redesign: Implementation added, because the brief asks for the first company to run on Grupo Vale's systems.
No Implementation phase for the second and third companies: the brief asks only for their integration plan.
